strength.excerpt: The amendment’s text prohibits the United States or any state from denying or abridging the right to vote on account of sex.
strength.note: Clearly states the amendment’s central protection.

weakness.excerpt: Congress passed the proposed 19th Amendment on June 4, 1919. It was ratified on August 18, 1920.
